Company: TBD Investors
Position: Software Engineering Intern
Type: Remote

About TBD Investors
TBD Investors is a family-office investment platform backing talented entrepreneurs acquiring and building enduring businesses across healthcare, business services, and other essential industries. Follow us: linkedin.com/company/tbd-investors/ | tbdinvestors.com

About the Role
We seek a curious, resourceful, and execution-oriented Software Engineering Intern to build technology across our portfolio. This is not an observational internship. You will take ownership of meaningful projects, collaborate with technical and nontechnical teams, and build tools that create measurable value for growing businesses. You will gain experience adapting technology to different industries, operating models, and stages of growth.

What You'll Do
- Build and improve internal web applications and operating tools
- Develop digital experiences for customers, employees, and business partners
- Automate repetitive workflows and manual processes
- Create integrations between operational, financial, clinical, and business systems
- Design and work with APIs, databases, and data pipelines
- Develop dashboards and tools that make business data accessible and actionable
- Explore practical applications of AI and emerging technologies
- Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code
- Test, debug, and improve software reliability
- Collaborate with portfolio company leaders across operations, product, analytics, finance, and strategy
- Monitor product performance and incorporate user feedback

Who Should Apply
We welcome undergraduate and graduate students in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, information systems, data science, applied mathematics, electrical engineering, or related technical disciplines. Strong self-taught developers from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Key Qualifications
- Comfortable programming in at least one modern language
- Familiar with software-development fundamentals
- Resourceful and able to learn new technologies quickly
- Interested in understanding how businesses operate
- Thoughtful about user experience, reliability, privacy, and security
- Strong problem solver and clear communicator
- Comfortable working independently in remote environment
- Proactive, dependable, and eager to take ownership
- Able to move between different projects, industries, and operating environments

Bonus Experience
Web development, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, automation, data engineering, or AI-assisted development. Prior private equity or specific industry experience not required.

What You'll Gain
- Hands-on experience building and deploying software in real operating businesses
- Opportunity to work across multiple portfolio companies and industries
- Ownership of projects with tangible operational or customer impact
- Direct exposure to entrepreneurs, executives, and the TBD Investors team
- Experience at the intersection of technology, operations, product, and strategy
- Portfolio of substantive work demonstrating technical ability and business judgment
- Mentorship and exposure to careers in software engineering, entrepreneurship, and investing
